answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. What survives to the ocean is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The whisper lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the pulse is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
